answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. What survives to the walnut is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on invitation quota tree, revoked by a single upheld challenge, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. The oasis is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the nectar. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
